article.headline: Rolison scores 26 as SE Louisiana takes down Northern Colorado 70-60
article.description: — Tyler Rolison’s 26 points helped SE Louisiana defeat Northern Colorado 70-60 on Tuesday.
article.linkText: Rolison scores 26 as SE Louisiana takes down Northern Colorado 70-60

categories.description: SE Louisiana Lions @ Northern Colorado Bears

event.description: SE Louisiana Lions @ Northern Colorado Bears

keywords: SE Louisiana Lions @ Northern Colorado Bears
article.story: CANCUN, Mexico -- — Tyler Rolison’s 26 points helped SE Louisiana defeat Northern Colorado 70-60 on Tuesday. Rolison added three steals for the Lions (2-4). Tybo Bailey scored 13 points while going 5 of 9 (2 for 5 from 3-point range). Manning Shareef led the Bears (3-4) in scoring, finishing with 16 points. Andrew Crawford added 12 points for Northern Colorado. Langston Reynolds finished with 10 points, nine rebounds, five assists and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
